description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for three different sentiment analysis models—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—when applied to three distinct tweet categories. The horizontal axis represents the tweet categories: “Emoji Tweets”, “Overall Tweets containing emojis”, and “Overall Tweet emojis”, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at 0.2 intervals. For each category, there are three bars representing the accuracy of each model; TEXTBLOB bars are white with a black outline, VADER bars are diagonally striped, and ChatGPT bars are solid green. For “Emoji Tweets”, TEXTBLOB has an accuracy of approximately 0.3, VADER has an accuracy of approximately 0.6, and ChatGPT has an accuracy of approximately 0.5. For “Overall Tweets containing emojis”, TEXTBLOB has an accuracy of approximately 0.5, VADER has an accuracy of approximately 0.7, and ChatGPT has an accuracy of approximately 0.6. For “Overall Tweet emojis”, TEXTBLOB has an accuracy of approximately 0.6, VADER has an accuracy of approximately 0.7, and ChatGPT has an accuracy of approximately 0.7. The bars are grouped by category, with each model’s accuracy represented side-by-side within each group. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
